note: Access Bank Liberia's tariffs for banking products and services (effective 1 March 2026): maintenance fees are charged on current accounts (a personal one 1,000 Liberian dollars, with no period stated) but none on an individual savings account, which the Central Bank of Liberia's regulation on interest rates says isn't to be read as authorising monthly charges.

sources.title: Access Bank Liberia, Tariffs for Banking Products and Services (effective 1 March 2026)
sources.said: Tariffs for Banking Products and Services from March 1, 2026 ... Effective Date: 3/1/2026 ... Maintenance Fees: Liberian Dollars US Dollars ... Personal 1,000.00 5.00 ... Savings Account ... Individual Savings Account 2,000.00 10.00

sources.title: Central Bank of Liberia, Regulation No CBL/SD/01/2004 concerning interest rate determination
sources.said: REGULATION CONCERNING INTEREST RATE DETERMINATION ... This provision shall not be construed as authorizing the levying of monthly charges on savings account.
